handoff.how_it_connects: Grok Bot custom MCP server / plugin (Settings -> Plugins). Paperclip side: external agent or HTTP adapter.
handoff.instruction:
Task for Grok Bot (dry run, do not publish): prepare a social post draft for "Tensiómetro digital de brazo".
Goal: awareness. Audience: adultos 35-65 que controlan su salud en casa.
Constraints: Spanish (es_AR), no health or efficacy claims, include a 'consult your healthcare professional' line.
Use the connected social-media plugin only to LIST scheduling options. Return the draft and wait for human approval before any publish call.
handoff.expected_return: draft text + suggested schedule; no publish tool call
